description: [BROWSE] List active RRG listings, paginated, optionally scoped by brand_slug. Use when exploring the catalogue without a specific item in mind. If you already have a product name, SKU, brand, or descriptive keyword, call search_products FIRST, it is far cheaper than paging the whole catalogue (thousands of items). Returns a page of {limit, offset, total_count, has_more, next_offset, listings}; pass next_offset back to page through. Each listing has title, price in USDC, edition size, and remaining supply. Live on-chain minted count is in get_drop_details, not here. Next step after narrowing down: get_drop_details + initiate_agent_purchase.

brand_slug.description: Optional brand slug to filter listings by a specific brand

limit.description: Max listings to return (default 50, max 200). The catalogue has thousands of items, page through with offset.

offset.description: Number of listings to skip for pagination (default 0).

name: list_drops
